name: Cessna Citation Excel / XLS
summary: Popular midsize Citation that mates a deep stand-up cabin with a straight Citation wing; a fractional and charter staple (NetJets, Flexjet) in the US.

engines: Two Pratt & Whitney Canada PW545 turbofans in fairly large pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Short, deep, round-sectioned fuselage giving a chunky, tall-cabin look
XLS+ / Gen2 have a reshaped, more pointed nose
tail: Tailplane mounted low on the tail cone with strong dihedral (not a T-tail)

tellTales: Chunky, deep fuselage on a straight unswept wing
Tailplane low on the tail cone with strong dihedral, not on top of the fin
Large engine pods close to the trailing edge of the wing

confusedWith.howToTell: The Excel/XLS fuselage is noticeably deeper and fatter; the Citation II/V/Encore is a slim, low tube with smaller engines.
The Excel/XLS has a low-set tailplane; the Latitude has a T-tail and a much fatter, rounder fuselage.
The Excel's tailplane sits low on the tail cone and its wing is straight; the Hawker has a mid-fin tailplane, swept wing and oval windows.
